Problem:

Manoel testou sua pontaria lançando cinco flechas no alvo reticulado de quadrados de comprimento $1~\mathrm{cm}$, ilustrado na figura. Uma flecha que acerta dentro do círculo menor conta 300 pontos; na regi∫o sombreada conta 100 pontos, entre a regi∫o sombreada e o círculo maior conta 50 pontos e fora do círculo maior n∫o conta nada. As flechas de Manoel acertaram os pontos
$$
A=(1,-1),\ B=\left(\frac{5}{2}, 1\right),\ C=(1,-4),\ D=(-4,-4)\ \text{e}
$$
$E=(6,5)$.
![](figures/mathnet_02kb__1.jpg)

a. Marque na figura os pontos onde Manoel acertou suas flechas.

b. Quantas flechas ele acertou no interior do menor círculo?

c. Quantos pontos Manoel fez no total?

hinge.title: When a data set is given as numbers or dots, decide that the mean must use the sum of all values divided by the number of values, counting repeated values each time they occur.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Sum of values is the label that belongs on this item, so 'When a data set is given as numbers or dots, decide that the mean must' is answered as sum of values rather than mean.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Sum of values is what produces mean, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about When a data set is given as numbers or dots, decide.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: mean is settled by running 'When reading an infographic with a colour scale, decide what the': In the wheat-rice infographic, the colour scale encodes the difference between per capita — on the item about When a data set is given as numbers or dots, decide.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Mean is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 65 as the reported result — on the item about When a data set is given as numbers or dots, decide.

intelligence.enrichment: The mean of a data set is the total of all the values divided by how many values there are. If a value appears several times, each occurrence contributes to both the total and the count.
